descriptionSet.display: Ḩārat Burj al-Mākāsir is one of the three traditional settlement quarters of Birkat al-Mawz oasis, the others being Ḩārat as-Saybani and Ḩārat al-Wādī (or Ḩillat as Sūq). The name is derived from the prominent round-plan tower (burj) located on a rocky outcrop that dominates the settlement quarter, rising above a cluster of small dwellings formed around its base. Located at the southern foothills of Al Jabal al Akhḑar mountains, along with Saybani it defines the northern edge of the oasis. A falaj (pl. aflāj) irrigation channel that extends eastwards from Ḩārat as-Saybani passes through the settlement quarter and provides domestic water and irrigates the upper reaches of the date palm plantations surrounding it. Another falaj channel cuts across north to south through the oasis near Ḩārat Burj al-Mākāsir as a prominent raised aqueduct.

description.source: Ministry of Heritage and Culture Sultanate of Oman, Birkat al-Mawz: Harat as-Saybani. Documentation and Heritage Management Plan, Masqaṭ: Mazoon Printing and Advertising L.L.C., 2014
